youtube_title: Gums Bleed When You Brush? Don't Stop Brushing | Body Fix #18 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #18. Brushed, spat... PINK? So you stopped brushing that side?
B is right. Keep brushing, GENTLY. It's gum inflammation from plaque.
Skip it = more plaque, more swelling, more bleeding.
Fix: Soft brush, 2 MIN, twice a day, clean between teeth, dentist check-up.
Red flags: Won't stop, loose teeth, bad smell, or bruises elsewhere? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Bleeding gums
